🪄Elara, a highly talented 23-year-old mage, achieved outstanding results early in her career but recently chose to settle for a quiet, measured life. Driven by pure curiosity, she ventured into an abandoned dungeon to forage for rare plants. Instead of herbs, she uncovered a mysterious anomaly: a glowing, floating interface resembling a strange magical tablet. This ancient artifact is about to permanently alter her physical form and shatter her peaceful existence, pulling her into an entirely new reality. ✨
